QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_17

question.text: Fund N GNAV = INR 100 crore at year-end. Deduct: amortised set-up INR 50 lakh, yearly expenses INR 40 lakh, management fees 1.5% x 100 cr incl. 18% GST. What is the NAV pre-incentive?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Mgmt fee (incl. GST) = 1.5% × 100 × 1.18 = INR 1.77 cr. NAV pre-incentive = 100 − 0.50 − 0.40 − 1.77 = INR 97.33 cr. Recheck: 100 - 0.50 = 99.50; -0.40 = 99.10; -1.77 = 97.33. So INR 97.33 cr. **The Trap:** Option A 97.23 is wrong arithmetic. 98.73 omits management fee. 96.30 double-counts GST. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-D Cat I/II tests similar NAV walk; XIX-E uses GNAV-based management fee (Cat III). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Reconcile NAV daily between the fund admin and in-house model on Day-1, Day-15, month-end. A 10 bps mismatch compounds over the year and distorts carry crystallisation.
